D: A young hunter is turned into a bear and travels with an orphaned cub to the place where the lights touch the earth.
P: Serve the mains when the bears gather at the salmon run.
S: Rye crispbread with cream cheese, smoked salmon, dill and lemon
Rye crispbread spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, dill and a squeeze of lemon, laid out on a wooden board.
Koda leading Kenai through the forest

Blueberries, raspberries and blackberries tossed with a little honey, spooned into bowls over whipped cream. Toss 150g blueberries, 150g raspberries and 150g blackberries with 2 tbsp honey and the zest of half a lemon and stand for 10 minutes so the juices run. Whip 300ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and a few drops of vanilla to soft peaks. Spoon the cream into 4 bowls, pile the berries and their juices on top and scatter with 40g crushed toasted hazelnuts.
Pecans and walnuts roasted in maple syrup with a pinch of salt
Pecans and walnuts tossed with maple syrup and salt, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes and cooled into clusters.
M: Salmon fillets brushed with maple syrup and grainy mustard, roasted at 200C for 15 minutes, with dill-buttered baby potatoes. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, drain and toss with 30g butter, chopped dill and salt. Mix 3 tbsp maple syrup with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and a squeeze of lemon. Lay 4 salmon fillets on a lined tray, season and brush with half the glaze. Roast at 200C for 12 to 15 minutes, brushing with the rest halfway, until just cooked in the middle. Serve with the potatoes and lemon wedges.
Venison steaks with a blueberry sauce and rosemary roast potatoes

Venison steaks seared rare and rested, sliced with a glossy blueberry, thyme and balsamic sauce and crisp rosemary roast potatoes. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes, toss with oil, rosemary and salt and roast at 220C for 45 minutes. Bring 4 venison steaks to room temperature, oil and season. Sear in a very hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side for rare and rest 5 minutes. Add 150ml beef stock, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 150g blueberries, 1 tbsp brown sugar and a thyme sprig to the pan and simmer 5 minutes until syrupy, then whisk in 20g butter. Slice the venison and spoon over the sauce.
W: Mixed berries with honey under an oat crumble
Mixed berries tossed with honey under an oat, butter and brown sugar crumble, baked at 180C for 35 minutes, with cream.
K: Blueberry syrup mixed with lemon juice and water, over ice

Fresh lemonade shaken with a blueberry and mint syrup, poured over ice and topped with soda so it swirls purple and green like the spirit lights. Simmer 150g blueberries with 80g caster sugar and 80ml water for 5 minutes, then strain and cool. Mix the juice of 4 lemons with 2 tbsp of the syrup and 400ml cold water. Fill 4 glasses with ice, a few mint leaves and blueberries. Pour in the lemonade, then spoon the rest of the blueberry syrup over the top and finish with a splash of soda water.
